reason: README explicitly identifies the plugin as a marketplace dashboard embedded in the DSH settings panel that presents and filters the `dsh-plugin` GitHub topic repository list with charts and stats, so the primary user-facing purpose is a navigation/panel-style marketplace interface for browsing plugin ecosystem data.

summaries.zh: 这是一个集成到 DSH Web 设置中的插件市场看板，展示 `dsh-plugin` 生态仓库的统计与仓库列表，并提供搜索筛选、语言分布和分页加载以便快速浏览。
summaries.en: This plugin is a marketplace dashboard integrated into the DSH Web settings area, showing `dsh-plugin` repositories with stats, searchable filters, language distribution, and paginated browsing.

capabilities: Displays GitHub repository metadata in a dashboard-style settings panel for discovery and monitoring of `dsh-plugin` projects
Fetches topic repository data from GitHub Search API with batched pagination and refresh progress handling
Falls back to an embedded snapshot of repository data when live fetch fails

reasons.code: README states the plugin is a dashboard for the GitHub `dsh-plugin` topic, integrated into DSH Web settings under "设置 → 插件市场" with repository cards, stats cards, and language chart UI.
README describes one-click refresh using batched GitHub Search API queries to fetch all repositories and handle rate limits, with a progress bar, while retaining bundled snapshots on failure.
README lists search by name/description and language dropdown filtering plus paginated cards (120 per page) as core functionality.
